correctness.rationale: For all n>=1, d>=1, 0<=k<d over C, the archival parameterization identifies O_{k,n,d} as projective image of pairs ([L],[F]) under [L^(d-k)F]. The 1-parameter diagonal subgroup with weights B^i (integer B>d) has distinct degree-d monomial weights; hence its fixed points in ambient projective space are precisely monomial points. The osculating variety is invariant, and a fixed monomial M=L^(d-k)F forces L to divide M. Unique factorization makes L a coordinate variable, so exactly monomials with some exponent >=d-k survive. Choosing j constrained variables leaves d-j(d-k) stars-and-bars units, giving the stated inclusion-exclusion formula up to min(n+1,floor(d/(d-k))). Compactly supported Euler localization chi_c(Y)=chi_c(Y^{C*}) applies also to singular projective varieties, and projectivity gives ordinary chi. When d>2k no double intersections exist, giving (n+1)binom(n+k,n). At k=0 count n+1; at k=d-1 the variety is the full ambient projective space; k=d is separately ambient and not substituted into a zero divisor. Independently implemented exact enumeration checked 396 triples with 478,621 monomial test instances (n=1..6,d=1..11,k<d) including base-B weight injectivity, formula, stable and endpoint cases; finite checks corroborate but do not prove universal quantifiers.
residual_risks: No claim about Betti numbers, mixed Hodge structure, singularities, defining ideals, or higher secant varieties.
The source checker and independent finite checks do not replace the algebraic localization proof.

value.rationale: The family of osculating Veronese varieties is a classical natural object in algebraic projective geometry. The topological Euler characteristic is an independently meaningful global invariant, not determined by dimension or secant defectivity. The formula supplies a uniform three-parameter exact answer, the sharp no-overlap threshold d>2k, and fully evaluated inclusion-exclusion corrections in the overlap range d<=2k. It can serve as a baseline for more refined topological or characteristic-class computations. The contribution is narrow/elementary and does not compute Betti groups, Hodge data or general secant invariants; n=1 and tangential subfamilies have relevant earlier coverage.
residual_risks: The fact is topologically coarse and proof is short; do not claim a new universal localization theorem or higher-secants result.
Future use of the precise invariant is plausible, not demonstrated by a new downstream theorem.

final_claim: For n>=1,d>=1,0<=k<d, chi_top O_{k,n,d}=sum_{1<=j<=min(n+1,floor(d/(d-k)))} (-1)^(j+1) C(n+1,j) C(n+d-j(d-k),n), equal to count of degree-d monomials with some exponent>=d-k. For d>2k, chi=(n+1)C(n+k,n); k=d endpoint ambient chi=C(n+d,n).
limitations: Ordinary Euler characteristic only over C; no Betti, Hodge, singularity, degree or higher-secant conclusions.
Stable formula requires strict d>2k; all overlap cases included by full inclusion-exclusion.
No claim of historical priority for known n=1 binary coincident-root strata or k=1 tangential cases.
Full text of Ballico–Fontanari 2003 and Torrance 2026 not read; their accessible descriptions do not by themselves show all-parameter coverage.
Resultary/web no-hit is not proof of originality; residual risks stated.
